headline: Teaching-at-home requests, City Year partnership at Calcutt school, superintendent evaluation policy first reading, and Mixed Magic Theatre building-use proposal.
summary: The meeting covers a Mixed Magic Theatre proposal for a partnership with the City of Central Falls, and a City Year partnership at Calcutt school. It also includes a first reading of the superintendent evaluation policy and a discussion of the fiscal year 27 budget book.
items: Opening ceremony led by Central Falls High School team on transition program, inclusive technical and professional education, unified sports, and student national advocacy
Superintendent report on theme and priorities for the 2026-27 school year
Superintendent report with back-to-school updates on enrollment, hiring, and safety
Civic use of buildings: Mixed Magic Theatre proposal for a partnership with the City of Central Falls
Personnel recommendations: Human Capital Council memo dated August 11, 2026
Pending business: discussion of the fiscal year 27 budget book
Vote on partnership with City Year at Calcutt school
Discussion of the professional development structure for the School Board
Appointment of a representative to the School Building Committee
location: Room 310, Central Falls High School, 10 Higginson Avenue, Central Falls, RI
